thread:
Nora (Marketing): Draft for the Redwood Optimize launch post is up: https://docs.google.com/draft-optimize. Need quick reviews on headline variants, bench language, CTA routing (webinar vs demo), and embargo timing. Goal: publish Thurs 9am PT. PTAL pls.
Ben (Growth): Reading now. Suggest we A/B headline + CTA. Two headline options: 1) 'Cut token serving cost by up to 4x with Redwood Optimize' 2) 'Smarter batching, lower bills: Redwood Optimize'. Want to test which drives more webinar signups.
Elise (PM): Bench language must be precise. We measured on A100s w/ 8k context, batching=dynamic, int8 quant, baseline float32. Recommend 'up to 4x' and a short method note. I'll drop the test config into the appendix.
Raj (Eng): Confirm numbers from bench-run-2026.csv. Also there9s a tiny typo in the table markdown (missing column header). I'll patch the doc. Also request we link to artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/optimize/bench-2026 for reproducibility.
Hana (Design): Making two hero options (abstract + dashboard overlay). What dimensions do you want? Social preview needs 1200x630, blog hero 1600x900. Also will add alt text.
Owen (Legal): Quick legal check: remove any comparative claims vs named competitors. Also avoid absolutes ('always', 'never', 'guaranteed'). For the customer quote on latency please either attach written consent or anonymize (e.g., "a beta customer"). If embargoed, legal needs the embargo window.
Nora (Marketing): Good call. We'll anonymize customer quote. On embargo: can we set Wed 00:00 PT embargo lift, publish Thurs 9am PT? Need legal OK.
Owen (Legal): Wed 00:00 PT embargo ok from legal side. Please ensure PR & press list receive embargo notice with copy in advance.
Ben (Growth): UTMs: campaign=optimize_launch, source=blog, medium=organic. If we A/B CTA, add variant tag: variant=a or variant=b. Example: 
```
https://redwood.com/webinar-register?utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_content=cta_variant_a
```
Nora (Marketing): CTA routing: webinar (HubSpot form id=42) vs demo (Calendly link that creates hubspot contact). Which do we want as primary?
Maya (Sales): Recommend webinar primary for broad reach; demos via secondary CTA with Calendly. HubSpot mapping: tag leads with "optimize_launch" and if source=demo escalate to AE. I9ll update the playbook. SLA: 24 hours for webinar leads, immediate for demo requests.
Elise (PM): Can we include a short how-we-measured callout beneath the benchmark chart so readers understand config and limitations?
Raj (Eng): Added a one-liner: 'Measurements performed on an NVIDIA A100, 8k context, dynamic batching, int8 quantization; see full artifact.' Also fixed the markdown header.
Hana (Design): Uploaded hero_v1.png and hero_v2-annotated.svg to the doc. Included two alt text options.
Ben (Growth): I'll set up the A/B test in GA and our email list for the webinar push. Nora, confirm which headline is variant A vs B.
Nora (Marketing): Variant A = cost-focused headline; Variant B = product-benefit headline. I'll update the doc copy and set CTAs accordingly.
Owen (Legal): One more: remove the line that mentions 'customers saw 0.5x latency' 1 that reads like a guarantee. Replace with anonymized observation: 'beta users reported notable latency reductions in production.'
Nora (Marketing): Replaced and anonymized. Also added the UTM snippet near the CTA.
Maya (Sales): Confirmed HubSpot mapping: form id=42 -> tag optimize_launch -> queue 'webinars'. Calendly demo requests will create CRM tasks for AEs.
Ben (Growth): Social copy drafts in the doc. Plan: publish + thread on X + LinkedIn, then paid boost for top-performing headline. I'll queue schedules after publish.
Raj (Eng): Minor note: hero image contains sensitive internal dashboard metrics; please blur or replace before publishing.
Hana (Design): Blurred internal metrics in hero_v2 and uploaded publish-safe versions.
Nora (Marketing): All approvals? :thumbsup:
Ben (Growth): :thumbsup: will run A/B
Elise (PM): :thumbsup: method note added
Owen (Legal): :thumbsup: embargo & copy approved
Maya (Sales): :thumbsup: playbook updated
Hana (Design): :thumbsup: images updated
Nora (Marketing): Great, I'll schedule publish Thurs 9am PT and send embargo to press list Wed 00:00 PT. Closing thread.
